caption: Held-out healthy-disc exemplar from the sealed v3 test split. The visible ring supports ring-only TPS prediction; held-out truth is used only for evaluation. The calibrated ensemble envelope is shown with its test coverage context (88.3% pointwise versus a 90% target). This is a lower-bound healthy-surface test, not recovery of pre-wound anatomy.
data_origin: Sealed result summaries and identified local public-data inputs.
limitations: Descriptive evidence only; correlated views/subsets are not independent subjects.
Synthetic mesh-rendered depth is not a physical sensor measurement.
